reviews.text:
Meyer’s Pool Care remodeled my pool this year and did an awesome job!  Best part they did it less than a month.  They used high quality materials and their contractors did an outstanding job.
Garrison the job Forman, answered all my questions and followed up on things that needed addressing.   I would recommend Meyers Pool Care for all your pool needs.
reviews.author: Mike Ackerman

reviews.text:
Used them about a year or so ago and had a great experience. Then in the summer of 2025 had more issues. Made the mistake of looking elsewhere and paid for it. October 2025 had an issue with my motor and obscure sand filter and within 36 hours they had someone out and not only fixed the problem but gave me tips and tricks to better service my pool.

Cannot recommend these people enough and won't send my business elsewhere.
reviews.author: Matt Nolan

reviews.text: Used them to help get older pool pump motor replaced to buy time to replace the whole unit.  Reason for the stars is the system they use.  I approved the quote and no communication sent.  I had to ask when this would occur.  Approved another quote and still have heard from no one even after asking, which I had to ask for the invoice as well.  They need an upgrade to software they are using.
reviews.author: Chris Lucas

reviews.text: We’ve been a customer of Meyer’s for several years now. You won’t find a more honest and trustworthy group to help you maintain, fix, and even educate you on everything about your pool. Do yourself a favor and work with them, you won’t regret it.
reviews.author: Cody Loyd

reviews.text:
I called Meyer's Pool service because I thought I needed to replace my pool cleaners booster pump.  Andrew, from Meyer's Pool came out with a new booster pump, looked things over and said there was nothing wrong with my existing booster pump.   He made a few adjustments to my pool cleaners set up and I was back in business.
Andrew's honesty saved me a considerable amount of money.  Meyer's refunded me the deposit I had placed on the cost of the booster pump the very next day.
Great experience, with a great company!
They also replaced the mastik on my pool a couple of summers ago and did a great job.
If you're in need of pool repairs or service, you can't go wrong using Meyer's Pool Service.
Highly recommend this company.
reviews.author: Michael Moreau

reviews.text: I highly recommend Meyer‘s Pool Care. For four years they have provided high quality service for our pool. The excellent staff are quick to respond to any questions we may have.  The weekly service is a great value for the cost. We’re able to enjoy clear and clean water the entire season. Meyer’s does a great job maintaining our pool equipment,  and provides detailed instructions on winterizing when needed. Thanks Meyer‘s!
reviews.author: Ann Christopher

reviews.text: We recently had our pool resurfaced, installed a Wi-Fi app-based control system, replaced our mastic, and updated the stonework around our spa. Meyer's Pool Care exceeded our expectations every step of the way. Their communication throughout the process was outstanding, making what could have been a stressful project remarkably smooth and enjoyable. After reviewing bids on each project, I found that they consistently offered one of the best deals, and the quality of their work has been far superior to the other pool companies we've worked with in the past. It is truly a pleasure to work with them!
reviews.author: Matt Lambro

reviews.text:
In the profusion of pool related service providers....how can one company stand out against the rest?   Is it providing best-in-class service?   Obviously, but that speaks only to the dedication of a company.   What sets Meyer's Pool Care apart from the pack is their devotion.   This incorporates all the elements of dedication AND incorporates the crucial ingredients of love, care, and commitment.

The team is always friendly, professional, takes the time to explain and field questions, and genuinely care about making sure everything is perfect.   The owner, Rodney Meyer, even makes a point of reaching out, not just to make sure all of your needs were met....but to establish a personal relationship with customers.

A business operated by a family for three generations really tells you something about who they are, and there’s simply not a way for me to say enough good things about MPC!

I highly recommend Meyer’s Pool Care to anyone looking for reliable, expert pool services. They don’t just go above and beyond....they become part of your extended family, and that level of care is something so rare to find nowadays.
reviews.author: Richard Drew

reviews.text:
Rodney and his team have been extremely helpful with advise and service of our pool.  I was new to the whole pool thing, moving into our new home, but they came through with training and advice.  When repairs were needed, they offered help over the phone or in person,  repairing only what was needed and at competitive prices.
Thanks a million to these honest, ethical pool experts.
reviews.author: Steve LaMar

reviews.text: Have used for pool cleanings for the past few years. I like the summary they send me after every weekly cleaning. We also had them install a new cleaner and pool heater that can be controlled from your phone and easy to set scheduled. Super friendly team and great office staff to work with in case you ever need any other work done. Would highly recommend.
reviews.author: Nicholas Marchetti

reviews.text:
Updated review!! We have been using Meyers Pool Care for almost 3 years now for various different projects and repairs and I just want to say, I can’t recommend this company enough! Our pool pump wouldn’t turn on today and within a few short hours of me contacting them, Rodney the owner came out and fixed it for us. Everyone at this company we have ever dealt with is so friendly and helpful. I’m grateful we found them and look forward to continue giving them our business for many years to come.

We initially called Meyers Pool Care when our pump stopped working and have since had them out for a few smaller jobs. We moved into a house with an existing pool and are first time pool owners and Rodney and his team have been great about answering our many questions. They are honest and don’t try to upsell you on getting new equipment unless it’s necessary. They are instead focused on helping us optimize our existing setup. They are also responsive, friendly, and do great work at a fair price. We are very happy we found Meyers Pool Care and will continue using them for all our pool maintenance needs.
reviews.author: Lauren Cahoon

reviews.text: Meyer's has provided me with terrific customer service the past few months and are worthy of a perfect rating.  Quality and honorable service is becoming more rare, so I find Meyer's to be even more special.  Each employee I have worked with consistently provides friendly, prompt, professional, expert, quality, and respectful attention to my needs and abundant questions.  They seem genuinely happy to have me as a customer, and go above and beyond to ensure a professional job.
reviews.author: Melanie Via

reviews.text: We recently changed to Meyer's Pool Care, and have been very happy.   They cleaned up the green that our previous pool service ignored, and updated some of our equipment.  Everyone in the company who we have come in contact with has been very responsive and friendly.
reviews.author: Lori Joe

reviews.text: Meyer's Pool Service is the best provider of pool care in the area.  After being disappointed by several other companies, Meyer's demonstrates again and again what world class looks like.  From weekly cleanings and inspections to repairs and maintenance they are always right on target.  Well done!!!
reviews.author: Jim Thayer

reviews.text: Had an issue with an older Jandy iAquaLink device not hooking up with new internet provider.  Called one company and only recommended total replacement for nearly $3k.  I called Meyers who had serviced this pool with previous owner and they came out right away and came up with a better solution for 1/3 of the others proposed costs.  They ordered the part and had us up and running again very quickly.  Great service and appreciated the money saving recommendation!
reviews.author: Christopher Drenowatz

reviews.text: We recently signed Meyer's to take care of our small pool and they have taken all the worry of maintaining the proper chemical levels off my shoulders.  They are always prompt and take good care of our property.
reviews.author: Adam Harvell

reviews.text: We switched to Meyer’s a couple of years ago and couldn’t be happier! Their guys always do an amazing job and their customer service is the best! They come in rain or shine and service our equipment so fast any time we need a repair.
reviews.author: Jessica Marchetti

reviews.text: We've lived in Colleyville for 12 years and since we've first moved in we've loved working with Meyer's Pool Care.  They're always on time, they're responsive and each of the staff members is always kind and knowledgeable.  The best part is a they're a family run business and the Meyer's family are wonderful Christian people.  Our family highly recommends Meyer's Pool care for all of your pool needs.
reviews.author: Donald Hooton

reviews.text: We worked with Garrison and had our pool resurfaced and an overlay done on our entire back patio.  The team was great, working with us to customized what we wanted, communicating the schedule, and then executing it!  Would recommend this team to anyone looking to do pool resurface or patio overlays!
reviews.author: Mark Tatum

reviews.text: I called Meyer's to help with 2 faulty pool lights.  They gave me a quote that was under budget.  They showed up on time and took about half as long as expected to complete the work.  No mess, no problems.  Lights have been working great ever since.
reviews.author: Scott Gregory

reviews.text: Have engaged Meyer’s Pool Care for years.   Very personable and people of integrity at every level.  Fair, reasonable and faithful to consistently show up every week.  Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Gary Staats

reviews.text: We had a pool “refresh” done with Meyer Pool. It was evident from the initial call, all the way through the final walk through, that Rodney and company care about their clients.  Our pool looks great! These are folks you can trust.
reviews.author: Rick Callihan

reviews.text: I love my pool company!!! Meyer’s pool care has the best team and is very responsive for all our needs. If you live in Northeast Tarrant County, you should give them a call!
reviews.author: Zach Towery

reviews.text: This is the first time we used Meyer’s Pool Care.......I could not be more satisfied.  We had been using another local company whose service has dramatically declined over the last couple years.  Our technician, Andrew, was outstanding.  Follow up was professional and  timely.  Price was fair for the work completed and I will definitely use Meyer’s again for any pool equipment repairs.
reviews.author: Jerry Lenander

reviews.text: Meyer Pool Care has provided superb pool services since we moved here in 2017. I cannot express enough of their ethics and friendliness. It is rare to find this in a business today!
reviews.author: Bob Jeppson

reviews.text: We used Meyers Pool Care for an issue that had needed resolving for a while. They not only fixed our issue quickly and for a fair price but also went above and beyond. I missed the doorbell several times while they were here and when I finally answered the technician had patiently waited around so that he could make me aware of some water issues that we were having on our patio. This had nothing to do with our pool! We are so thankful he went the extra mile and saved us from an expensive plumbing issue. Great company and great employees!
reviews.author: Tiffany

reviews.text: This is my first experience dealing with Meyer's Pool Care and I must say they exceeded my expectations on every front.  In the world we live in today it has become apparant that true customer service and follow through has become a rare thing.  The team at Meyer's Pool Care delivered on all fronts.  I have never been more happy to pay an invoice!  From the initial call in to them to the invoice being sent to me, everything was terrific. Thank you!!
reviews.author: Brian Krukiel

reviews.text: Meyers Pool Care is awesome! They’ve done our pool for over 8 years, answer when we call, have the most courteous gentlemen clean our pool and are super honest about repairs and needs. We highly recommend them if you have a pool that needs serviced, cleaned, repaired or remodeled.
reviews.author: Stephanie Simons

reviews.text: We have been using Rodney and his team for over 10 years. They are reliable and great with both weekly maintenance and repair work. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Lindsay Safran

reviews.text: Took our Polaris there to get it fixed, they did a great job, luckily it just needed cleaned since it was clogged. They were fairly quick on the turn around and even dropped it off at our house when it was ready!
reviews.author: Megan Mosaddaque

reviews.text: Shawn does a great job of servicing our pool and the two Andrews have quickly replaced or repaired our pumps and filters over the 3 years we have been with Meyers. We have had 3 different pool servicemen since we began with Meyers; one of them was sub-par and Rodney replaced him fairly quickly.  Very pleased with the work of Shawn and the two Andrews.  Thanks Rodney.
reviews.author: Deborah

reviews.text: Meyers pool company have been taking care of our pool for several years now. They resurfaced and remodeled it two years ago. The entire staff is beyond professional and we feel have saved us money the way they have cared for our pool. The owner and the entire staff are also some of the nicest people we have the privilege of doing business with.
reviews.author: Donna Grupp

reviews.text: I had them out to address a pesky black algae war I was fighting. The tech arrived on time, educated me on some of the causes and cures, treated my water and it has never looked so good. No algaes of any kind have returned and it's been 3 months now. They know what they're doing!
reviews.author: Jim Avers

reviews.text: They have been servicing our pool for several years now. They are fantastic and very professional. The technician spends a tremendous amount time on our pool everytime they clean or service it.
reviews.author: tripp bushnell

reviews.text:
Meters customer service is excellent.  The lady that I spoke with was very helpful.
The young man that came for my pool service was the nicest young person I have met in a long time.  He was very knowledgeable.  Great service.
reviews.author: Carol Clark

reviews.text: Meyer's is fantastic!  They are quick to respond, super helpful, and always go above and beyond.  They definitely have a customer for life with me.  Great customer service is rare these days but Meyer's has is down pat!  Thank you!
reviews.author: Courtney Shook

reviews.text: I've used Meyer's Pool Care since we bought a house with a pool. The team has always made repairs to get the most out of the existing equipment. There is no pressure to make any unnecessary fixes or replacements.
reviews.author: Heath Alls

reviews.text: We recommend Meyer's Pool Care 100%.  They are friendly, honest, and quick to respond!  We completely trust Rodney and his crew to keep our pool running and looking beautiful!
reviews.author: Becky Davis

reviews.text: Snowing in Dallas last Sunday and connector to pool filter started spraying water everywhere.   Our pool company was not open to advise us.    Went online and asked who knew anything about pools and in three minutes Mrs. Meyer messaged us and her husband spent over half an hour talking me through draining all my above ground pool equipment before it froze.   We were in a panic and he saved us from expensive repairs.   Thank you Mr. and Mrs. Meyer!
reviews.author: Mark Mondress

reviews.text: Great service, fair price, friendly staff, excellent results. We have used them for major repairs and semiannual maintenance (filter cleaning) and now weekly service. We have been consistently pleased with their work.
reviews.author: Peter Janicki

reviews.text: Rodney and his staff have serviced our pool and our daughter's pool for several years now with the upmost professionalism and fairness. I would recommend this local company to any pool owner. Keep up the good work.
reviews.author: Jim Lewis

reviews.text: I would not trust my pool care to anyone else. Rodney and his team always do a great job!

reviews.text: Great service - I've been with others who are lacking but the Meyer team does a great job

reviews.text: Meyer's Pool Care is very professional, prompt and they take customer satisfaction very seriously. I couldn't recommend them more!
